name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
🧰 v3.16.0 — Diagnostic snapshot export + sprint-view fix

📸 Diagnostic snapshot export — the diagnostic panel’s «Export TXT» now saves a state snapshot instead of an event feed: app version, host environment (YouTrack version, storage/navigation availability), effective settings, all header zones of the selected sprint/role and the recent errors tail. Attach the file to a bug report — no HAR recording skills needed.

🩹 Correct «Remaining» when viewing another sprint — the remaining-hours card was computed from the working sprint’s resource while viewing a different sprint; it now reads the selected sprint’s per-role snapshot, consistent with the «Available resources» input and the accordion header.

🧪 Internals — an anonymized production-state fixture with cross-zone consistency invariants now guards sprint-switch paths in the test suite.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema change, no data migration.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), estimate and spent fields, planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
